fact_text: The federal excise duty on property was abolished in FY26, according to Abad chairman Hassan Bakhshi.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: A court ruling removed the 7E property tax, which the Abad chairman called a long-awaited positive for builders and ordinary buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The government cut one property withholding tax and exempted builders from another, according to the Abad chairman.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Subsidised home finance of up to 10 million (currency not named in the video) was offered to first-time buyers, not to builders.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: After the 7E removal, cash held as dollars or gold began moving into property, reviving buying and selling, the chairman said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The video relays an IMF remark that about 80% of laundered or black money is channelled into real estate, and calls for tighter monitoring.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman said the IMF programme focuses more on stability than growth, and that Pakistan must raise tax collection to exit it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Scandinavian countries with tax rates near 50% also fund schooling, health care and childcare, while Pakistani households pay for these privately, the chairman noted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Dubai charges a 4% property transfer tax, according to the chairman.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Pakistan's property transfer tax is 10 to 12% for filers, according to the chairman.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Pakistan's property transfer tax is 32% for non-filers, according to the chairman.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The filer and non-filer split confuses property investors, the chairman said, whereas Dubai and London buyers are not asked such a question.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman proposed making every buyer a filer by using the national identity card (CNIC) as the tax number, with a letter sent within 24 hours of a purchase.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman proposed a fixed tax per square foot of property instead of the earlier fixed-tax regime, to close routes for corruption and give the state steady revenue.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman's first demand is consistent property policy for 15 years, drafted with stakeholders so the sector understands the direction and shares ownership of it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman asked for land records and approvals to be digitised nationwide, arguing that digital records from day one stop land grabbing, as seen in Punjab.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman asked for a separate real estate court with cases decided within 3 months, saying disputes drag on for 15 to 40 years and let criminals and land grabbers profit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman asked the government, the highest judiciary and the Field Marshal to push judicial reform, which he said the economy and property rights need.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Once a RERA-style regulator is set up, an escrow account concept for buyer payments would follow, the chairman said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Karachi's ban on commercialisation and land-use change, in place for 7 years, was lifted after the Federal Constitutional Court granted relief.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Punjab auctions land parcels on instalment terms of about 5 to 7 years, with 15% paid upfront and the balance paid while building.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Punjab let developers register property from their own office through a portal, without visiting the registrar, a reform the chairman said had been missing for years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: Sindh is in talks to resolve builders' NOC problems in the FY27 Sindh budget, which the chairman said halt construction in Karachi.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman said Sindh has large demand but must perform, since capital and water flow to provinces that govern better, and that Sindh's departments have weakened.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman offered to run Sindh building control, promising plan approvals within 2 days with no bribes, using AI checks developed with a university.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: AI is being developed to monitor construction in progress and flag unapproved work, such as roof slabs laid without approval, on screens.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: More than 10 million overseas Pakistanis in the UK, US and Middle East are expected to seek a home in Pakistan, which the chairman said the Middle East crisis has made an opportunity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The FY27 federal budget was due to be announced in June 2026, according to the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman argued that buying property and doing business are constitutionally guaranteed rights, so tax rules should not deter legal buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)

fact_text: The chairman said the sector's own members should accept checks and work on transparency and merit, expecting Sindh and federal governments to recognise the effort.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What FY27 budget means for Pakistan’s property market | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-24)
